shortDescription: Public support for Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and his Bhumjaithai Party has plunged, according to Bloomberg reported, as the government faces rising oil prices and a court ruling that may threaten its hold on power.

title: Thai PM Anutin’s Support Falls as Oil Prices and Court Ruling Pressure Government
